string.text: Ctrl+V: sit or stand by a lit campfire. Move the mouse to look around automatically; the body stays fixed. Movement, jumping, leaning and drawing weapons are blocked. PDA and inventory mouse controls remain available. Ctrl+V stands up and restores controls. A hit interrupts rest. Bonus applies to LNCT Campfire Healing.
A lit campfire is needed nearby. Stay clear of the flames.
